scenes.title: Called from a Young Age
scenes.english_text: God spoke to young Jeremiah, saying, 'Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.' Jeremiah felt afraid because he was young, but God touched his mouth and promised, 'Do not be afraid, for I am with you to protect you.'
scenes.tetum_translation: Maromak ko'alia ba Jeremias ne'ebé ho sei juven, dehan, 'Molok Ha'u halo ó iha ina-nain laran, Ha'u koñese tiha ó no hili ó sai profeta ba nasaun sira.' Jeremias sente ta'uk tanba nia foin sa'e, maibé Maromak kona nia ibun no promete, 'Keta ta'uk, tanba Ha'u hela ho ó atu proteje ó.'
scenes.scene_summary: God calls young Jeremiah to be a prophet to the nations, promising to be with him always.

scenes.title: The Potter and the Clay
scenes.english_text: God sent Jeremiah to watch a potter shaping clay on his wheel. When a vessel was marred, the potter gently reworked it into another beautiful pot. God explained to Jeremiah, 'Just like clay in the potter's hand, so are you in My hands, O house of Israel. I can reshape you when you return to Me.'
scenes.tetum_translation: Maromak haruka Jeremias atu haree ema oulari ida halo osan-rahu husi rai-keta iha nia roda leten. Bainhira sasae ne'e aat, oulari ne'e ho kmanek halo fali sasae seluk ne'ebé furak. Maromak esplika ba Jeremias, 'Hanesan rai-keta iha oulari nia liman, nune'i imi iha Ha'u-nia liman, O umakain Izraél. Ha'u bele halo imi furak fali bainhira imi fila mai Ha'u.'
scenes.scene_summary: God uses a potter shaping clay to illustrate how He can reshape and restore His people.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a Hebrew prophet Jeremiah wearing a simple tunic standing inside an artisan workshop, watching a friendly potter shape a clay vase on a wooden spinning wheel. scenes.title: The Weeping Prophet's Warning
scenes.english_text: Jeremiah preached bravely in Jerusalem, weeping with sadness because the people refused to listen to God's warnings of coming exile. Enemies placed him in wooden stocks and threw him into a muddy cistern, but Jeremiah declared that God's word in his heart was like a burning fire he could not hold inside.
scenes.tetum_translation: Jeremias haklaken ho brani iha Jeruzalém, tanis ho tristeza tanba povu lakohi rona Maromak nia aviso kona-ba dadur tuir mai. Inimigu sira tau nia iha fatuk-rahun metin no soe nia ba kuak-bee suer laran, maibé Jeremias deklara katak Maromak nia liafuan iha nia laran hanesan ahi-lakan ne'ebé nia la bele tahan iha laran.
scenes.scene_summary: Jeremiah faithfully preaches God's word despite hardship, tears, and persecution in Jerusalem.

scenes.title: A Letter of Hope in Exile
scenes.english_text: When the people were taken away to Babylon, Jeremiah wrote them a comforting letter from God. He assured them, 'For I know the plans I have for you,' declares the Lord, 'plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.' God encouraged them to build homes, plant gardens, and pray.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira povu lori ba Babilónia nu'udar dadur, Jeremias hakerek karta ksolok nian husi Maromak ba sira. Nia asegura sira, 'Tanba Ha'u hatene planu ne'ebé Ha'u iha ba imi,' dehan Na'i, 'planu atu fó ksolok no la'ós estraga imi, planu atu fó esperansa no futuru di'ak.' Maromak fó kbiit ba sira atu harii uma, kuda to'os, no harohan.
scenes.scene_summary: Jeremiah sends a famous letter of hope to the captives in Babylon, sharing God's promise of a bright future.

scenes.title: The New Covenant Written on Hearts
scenes.english_text: God gave Jeremiah a glorious prophecy about a new day. God promised, 'I will make a new covenant with My people. I will put My law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be My people, for I will forgive their wickedness.' Jeremiah smiled, knowing God's love would never fail.
scenes.tetum_translation: Maromak fó profesia glória nian ida ba Jeremias kona-ba loron foun. Maromak promete, 'Ha'u sei halo aliansa foun ida ho Ha'u-nia povu. Ha'u sei tau Ha'u-nia ukun-fuan iha sira-nia hanoin no hakerek iha sira-nia laran. Ha'u sei sai sira-nia Maromak, no sira sei sai Ha'u-nia povu, tanba Ha'u sei fó perdua ba sira-nia sala.' Jeremias oin-haksolok, hatene Maromak nia domin sei la lakon.
scenes.scene_summary: Jeremiah prophesies God's glorious New Covenant, where His law will be written directly on human hearts.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Jeremiah teaches us to speak God's truth with love and tears, trusting that God has good plans and a hopeful future for us.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Jeremias hanorin ita atu ko'alia Maromak nia lian ho domin no tanis, fiar katak Maromak iha planu di'ak no futuru azu ba ita.
reflection.discussion_question_en: When you feel sad or face hard times, how can remembering God's promise of a hopeful future comfort your heart?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Bainhira ó sente triste ka hasoru tempu susar, oinsá hanoin-hetan Maromak nia promesa kona-ba futuru ne'ebé nakonu ho esperansa bele fó ksolok ba ó-nia laran?
